definitions.full: H4199. Mizzah מִזָּה proper name, masculine grandson of Esau Gen 36:13 , 17 ( ᵐ5 Μοζε ); 1Chr 1:37 ( ᵐ5 Ομοζε , ᵐ5 L Μαζε ). [ מָ֫זוּ ], מְזָוֵינוּ see זוה . מְזוּזָה see זוז . מָזוֺן see זון . I. מָזוֺר see III. זוּר II. מָזוֺר see II. מזר infra. below
definitions.rootNote: probably from an unused root meaning to faint with fear; terror ;

occurrences.englishText: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
